//: TypeScript covers the document application only. The rest of the repo is plain JavaScript and stays that way: allowJs lets a .tsx import a .js module, and checkJs keeps the compiler from grading a hundred files nobody wrote types for.
//exclude: services/ is EXCLUDED because it is not this application. Each folder under it is a separately deployed program with its own package.json, its own dependencies and its own tsconfig — services/pg-gateway needs @google-cloud/cloud-sql-connector, which the app neither has nor should have. `include` here is `**/*.ts`, so without this line the app's typecheck grades a service against dependencies that are not in the app's node_modules and fails on imports that are perfectly correct where they live. `next build` was never affected (Next compiles only what src/app imports); `tsc` was.
